race.comment: BUBBLES'N'FROTH (1) has the strongest overall case, returning from a five-week break after a Townsville third where the awkward start and being forced wide added merit to the run. His prior Townsville effort was also better than seventh reads, and the class relief keeps him firmly at the top. ELITE GATHERING (7) is the immediate danger after a narrow Class 2 third at Bowen, with the main task being to reproduce that on the back of a plain Townsville run two starts ago. ACCEPT POWER (8) brings the most eye-catching last-start finish, beaten a nose at Cairns after beginning awkwardly, and her 1300m place record keeps her right in play. BONNIE BOUQUET (6) is the fresh runner with upside, having won a Rockhampton 2-3yo Maiden as odds-on favourite before the break, though this BM55 asks for another step.
